lines.text: The pure gold has become dull, and Zion's precious sons are now esteemed as jars of clay.
The punishment of the daughter of my people is greater than that of Gomorrah, which was overthrown in an instant.
The dignitaries were once brighter than snow, but now their appearance is blacker than soot and they are not recognized.
This was for the sins of her kings and the guilt of her soldiers, who shed righteous blood.
Those who chased them were swifter than the eagles in the sky and ambushed them in the wilderness.
